reasoning_content: The `rm -rf` is conditional on `LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP==true`, and it's set to true in compose. I'll set it to false (keeping the config files is safe — the bootstrap guard uses FIRST_START_DONE and empty directories).

action.command: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG=false/KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG=true/; s/LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=true/LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=false/' .ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml && grep -n 'KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG\|REMOVE_CONFIG' .ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml && su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && ddev start' 2>&1 | tail -8

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && sed -i 's/KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG=false/KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG=true/; s/LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=true/LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=false/' .ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml && grep -n 'KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG\\|REMOVE_CONFIG' .ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml && su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && ddev start' 2>&1 | tail -8", "summary": "Set KEEP_EXISTING_CONFIG=true, REMOVE_CONFIG=false, ddev start", "security_risk": "HIGH"}
